title: Actual shared method_loop owns iteration and integration
result: The binding imports the actual OpenChia implementation. Source selection, acquisition, projection/report admission, one local controller advance, record append, hook and stop obedience follow the real loop. Allowed parent/child edges and Goal linkage are enforced; no private scientific optimizer or forced math/simulation sequence replaces it.
evidence_limits: Source trace and all 27 closed records; recursive simparts is allowed but depth beyond the observed three levels was not reached. Semantic scope defects remain D01/D02.

title: One local acquisition is one local controller observation
result: 375 direct tool acquisitions and 27 child returns account for 402 local unit events; root has 20 turns. Child internal operations do not each advance an ancestor. A saved-observation comparison performs no integration. Solver duration, samples and steps do not multiply estimator exposure.
